description: Adversarial FRAUD_DETECTION scoring corpus. Each case has a question, a ground_truth verdict+reason, and tiered answers (high = correct verdict + good evidence, mid = safe abstention, low = wrong/dangerous verdict). Tier ordering is the metric: a correct scorer must rank high > mid > low.
